description: This file defines a mock class 'SharedMemoryBufferMock' for the 'ISharedMemoryBuffer' interface, used in unit testing to simulate shared memory buffer behavior in the Rialto server component.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISharedMemoryBuffer interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: mapPartition
methods.description: Mocks mapping a media playback partition.

methods.name: unmapPartition
methods.description: Mocks unmapping a media playback partition.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Mocks clearing data in a media playback partition.

methods.name: getDataOffset
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the data offset within the shared memory.

methods.name: getMaxDataLen
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the maximum data length.

methods.name: getDataPtr
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a pointer to the data buffer.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the file descriptor associated with the shared memory.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a pointer to the entire buffer.
